title: Promise to Invoke Alien Enemies Act
description_short: Promise to Invoke Alien Enemies Act
description_medium: During his campaign in the fall of 2024, Trump explicitly promised to invoke the Alien Enemies Act of 1798 on his first day in office to carry out mass deportations. This obscure wartime law allows the president to detain and deport noncitizens from a 'hostile' nation without due process. Legal experts warned that using this law during peacetime to bypass immigration courts would be a massive executive overreach and a violation of constitutional rights.

title: Columbia University Capitulates to Trump Demands
description_short: Columbia University Capitulates to Trump Demands
description_medium: Columbia University reached an agreement with the Trump administration in spring 2025 after the White House threatened federal funding cuts over pro-Palestinian protests on campus. Columbia agreed to ban face masks at protests, strengthen campus security, and modify oversight of its Middle East studies programs. The deal was condemned by faculty and civil liberties organizations as an unconstitutional surrender of academic freedom. It set a precedent other universities feared would be used against them.

title: DHS Requests 20,000 National Guard Troops for Domestic Interior Immigration Raids
description_short: DHS Requests 20,000 National Guard Troops for Domestic Interior Immigration Raids
description_medium: On May 9, 2025, the Department of Homeland Security formally requested 20,000–21,000 National Guard troops from the Pentagon to conduct 'expansive interior immigration enforcement operations' across the United States — the first such domestic request in US history. The 21-page request included tasks such as fugitive tracking with 'night operations and rural interdictions,' surveillance and canvassing missions, and transporting detainees between states. Defense officials warned the deployment could violate the Posse Comitatus Act if federalized.

title: Maine Secretary of State Removes Trump from Ballot
description_short: Maine Secretary of State Removes Trump from Ballot
description_medium: On December 28, 2023, Maine Secretary of State Shenna Bellows became the first state official to unilaterally remove a presidential candidate from the ballot, ruling Trump disqualified under the 14th Amendment insurrection clause. Bellows cited Trump role in the January 6 Capitol attack in her decision. Trump appealed. The ruling was stayed pending Supreme Court review. Combined with the Colorado ruling, the decisions forced the Supreme Court to definitively address whether January 6 constituted insurrection.

title: Trump 90-Day China Tariff Pause, Markets Surge
description_short: Trump 90-Day China Tariff Pause, Markets Surge
description_medium: After weeks of market turmoil caused by sweeping tariffs, Trump announced a 90-day pause on most Chinese tariffs in May 2025, sending stock markets sharply higher. The partial reversal was framed as a negotiating breakthrough, though critics noted Trump had created the crisis in the first place. The pause reduced the effective tariff rate on Chinese goods from 145% to 30%. Markets recovered briefly before renewed uncertainty about the trade war's end state resumed volatility.

title: Hegseth Signal Chat Leaks Yemen Strike Plans to Journalist Jeffrey Goldberg
description_short: Hegseth Signal Chat Leaks Yemen Strike Plans to Journalist Jeffrey Goldberg

title: Trump Forces Soybean Farmers to Take $28 Billion in USDA Bailouts From China Tariffs
description_short: Trump Forces Soybean Farmers to Take $28 Billion in USDA Bailouts From China Tariffs
description_medium: After his China tariffs devastated American soybean farmers who lost their largest export market, the Trump administration authorized approximately $28 billion in USDA bailout payments to agricultural producers. Critics noted this was effectively a government-funded attempt to paper over the self-inflicted damage of Trump's trade war. The bailout money largely benefited large agribusinesses rather than small family farmers. The episode illustrated how Trump's tariff policies required expensive government intervention to prevent complete agricultural sector collapse.
